name: Gumlet
description: Integrate Gumlet with Claude using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to manage your video and image infrastructure without leaving your chat. This connector lets Claude query media analytics, manage video assets, configure encoding profiles, and inspect delivery settings through natural language commands.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gumlet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gumlet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gumlet.com/mcp/v1.

_published_faq.name: Is Gumlet MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Gumlet scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gumlet MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gumlet lists 70 MCP tools, including add_asset_playlist, asset_audio_upload, asset_status_history, complete_audio_upload, complete_live_stream, complete_multipart_upload, complete_subtitle_upload, create_asset, create_asset_direct_upload, create_folder, create_image_source, and create_live_asset.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gumlet?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gumlet in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Gumlet does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Gumlet failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gumlet scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Gumlet is developed by Gumlet. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
